scope: Case-specific numerical convergence criteria for the experimental multi-shell CI; these are not universal safe cutoffs or external physical validation.

cases.description: H beta at one fixed Holtsmark normal field under a condition drawn from the B=500 T, Ne=1e23 m^-3 Ferri-style example.
limitations: The calculation uses one fixed electric-field magnitude rather than a microfield distribution.
The lower n=2 space is separate and is excluded from the upper CI basis.
Passing is relative to the stated finite reference basis, not an infinite-basis proof.
No comparison with the Ferri profile or another external calculation is made.

cases.description: H beta at the low magnetic-field boundary and zero fixed electric microfield.
limitations: This is a zero-electric-field endpoint, not a microfield average.
The lower n=2 space is separate and is excluded from the upper CI basis.
Passing is relative to the stated finite reference basis, not an infinite-basis proof.
No comparison with an external line profile or calculation is made.
